prompt: CSSFontFeatureValuesMap set method exception too many values
answer:
`CSSFontFeatureValuesMap.set()` throws an `InvalidAccessError` when the supplied sequence contains more values than the associated feature-value block allows.

Limits include:

- `@styleset`: unlimited values
- `@character-variant`: one or two values
- `@ornaments`: exactly one value
- `@stylistic`: exactly one value
- `@swash`: exactly one value
- `@annotation`: exactly one value

For example, setting two values for an `@ornaments` entry exceeds its limit and causes `InvalidAccessError`.
